Any good instant alternatives to Maruchan taste of asia?
I used to LOVE the taste of asia line from Maruchan. Their pork tonkotsu and Sukiyaki were so good! They still have the spicy miso but since they discontinued the other two i have never found one that was as good. Does anyone know of any brands that are as good, preferably one I can buy online (I live in hawaii).
